title: IMS Bearings — Experimental Source and Local-Only Inspection Metadata
creator_or_provider: Center for Intelligent Maintenance Systems (IMS), University of Cincinnati; Rexnord Technical Services
distributor: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) — upstream archive; MotorPulse AI does not distribute it
citation: J. Lee, H. Qiu, G. Yu, J. Lin, and Rexnord Technical Services (2007). IMS, University of Cincinnati. Bearing Data Set. NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA.

license.original_or_derived_redistribution: unverified; HOLD pending source-specific rights confirmation

collection.method: Third-party run-to-failure bearing vibration experiment; optional user-provided local ASCII file inspection
collection.temporal_timestamps: Timestamp-shaped source filenames have unknown timezone; not converted to UTC
collection.actual_independent_runs: IMS test-set/run is conservative grouping boundary; rig/bearing independence still requires documentation

labels.notes: External references mention run-end failures; validated per-window fault labels and onset remain unknown.

measurement_quality.missingness: User-supplied local reports contain review flags; do not infer full archive missingness
measurement_quality.outliers: High crest or flatline is a review prompt, not a verified failure mode
measurement_quality.calibration: Native physical vibration units, true channel-to-bearing mapping and timezone not verified by the project

recommended_splits: Treat whole IMS test set/run and all related channels/timestamps as one group. Never random-split adjacent windows; fit scalers using training groups only.
intended_uses: Documenting original dataset source, contributors, and uncertainty
Optional research with user-supplied local records under applicable source terms
Preparing reproducible run-group validation plans with unknown labels preserved
excluded_uses: Publishing original recordings or derived IMS features to this GitHub repository before rights review
Inferring per-window fault onset or RUL without evidence
Assuming synthetic motor sample rate, units or fault classes apply
Claiming dataset-specific public-domain or commercial redistribution rights
known_limitations: Original IMS archive not obtained or inspected by this project
Archive-specific license and redistribution rights unresolved
Original acquisition rate, record count, channel map, physical units and timezone not verified
No actual IMS evaluation results, per-window onset ground truth or transferable RUL measurements

rights_review.notes: NASA hosting alone is not proof that third-party IMS source and derived materials may be redistributed; source-specific terms still unverified.
